deviceUnresponsiveHint: Your computer isn't answering right now. Retrying automatically.
connectStep1: Install and open {{appName}} on your computer
connectStep2: Sign in with the same account as your phone
connectStep3: Under Settings → Remote Access, turn on "Allow same-account devices to control this computer"
cloudTeaserCopy: Once it launches, the mobile app works on its own, no computer needed.
authFailedHint: Your sign-in has expired. Sign out and sign in again.
replacedHint: This device connection was replaced elsewhere. Reconnecting now.
tooManyConnectionsHint: Too many devices are online for this account. Disconnect another device and try again.
versionMismatchHint: This app version is incompatible with the service. Update to the latest version and try again.
unstableHint: Connection keeps dropping and reconnecting — check the network, or restart the app if it persists.

hint.connecting: Remote tasks will resubscribe automatically when the network recovers.
hint.stopped: The connection will resume when you return to the app or sign in again.

agentAuth.noKey: {{agent}} can't be used because no API key is configured on the computer. Configure one in {{appName}} on the computer under Settings → Model Providers, then try again.
agentAuth.noOauth: {{agent}} can't be used because account authorization isn't complete on the computer. Reconnect the account in {{appName}} on the computer under Settings → Model Providers, then try again.
agentAuth.noCredentials: {{agent}} can't be used because it isn't signed in on the computer. Sign in through {{appName}} on the computer under Settings → Model Providers, then try again.
agentAuth.noEncryption: {{agent}} can't be used because secure system storage on the computer is unavailable. Check Keychain on macOS or account encryption on Windows, then restart {{appName}} on the computer.
agentAuth.proxyNotReady: {{agent}} isn't ready on the computer yet. Try again shortly; if this continues, restart {{appName}} on the computer.
agentAuth.default: {{agent}} can't be used because its computer sign-in is unavailable. Sign in again through {{appName}} on the computer under Settings → Model Providers. ({{reason}})

remoteError.remoteDisabled: The controlled computer has disabled remote control.
remoteError.channelNotAllowed: The current desktop version doesn't support this remote capability.
remoteError.accessRevoked: This computer has revoked mobile access.
remoteError.deviceUnresponsive: The computer isn't responding. Automatic retry is in progress; try again shortly.
remoteError.versionMismatch: The service protocol version doesn't match. Update the app and try again.
remoteError.payloadTooLarge: This transfer is too large. Split it into smaller parts and try again.
remoteError.mediaFetchFailed: The file couldn't be fetched from the computer. Try again later.
remoteError.voiceTranscribeFailed: Voice transcription failed. Try again or use the keyboard.
remoteError.linkNotOpen: The control link to the computer was disconnected and is reconnecting.
remoteError.accountChanged: The Codex account or workspace changed. Refresh the quota and confirm again.
remoteError.offerExpired: The Codex reset offer expired. Refresh the quota and confirm again.
remoteError.preconditionFailed: The operation conditions changed. Refresh and confirm again.
remoteError.transient: The network or controlled computer is temporarily unavailable. Sync again later.
remoteError.callFailed: The remote call failed. Try again later. ({{error}})
